doctrine.notes: This registry describes evidence maturity of portfolio assets. Gauntlet opportunity status, execution state, and G0-G6 gates remain separate authorities. A route may use multiple assets with different maturity and must not inherit a fabricated single maturity score.

assets.name: Cite-Agent
assets.strongest_known_gap: Current repository/deployment/external-use state has not yet been re-audited in this canonicalization pass.
assets.evidence_basis: Existing portfolio asset; intentionally conservative until current source state is re-audited.

assets.name: YZU / Research Drive
assets.strongest_known_gap: External adoption/independent validation remains distinct from the known internal live deployment.
assets.evidence_basis: Canonical main reconciled 2026-08-27 to deployed backend lineage after Backend release proof and Private runtime contract passed; exact deployed ref remains separately pinned.

assets.name: Policy Lab / CL-ECI
assets.strongest_known_gap: External research/community adoption or independent replication is not established.
assets.evidence_basis: Executable research software with reproducibility gates and a public-data checkpoint; GAF portal-ready RC5 work remains on a small release branch ahead of main.

assets.name: Nocturnal Oversight
assets.strongest_known_gap: One bounded externally witnessed analyst/fact-checker/steward pilot showing measurable workflow or correctness benefit. Do not reopen architecture before external use exposes an actual failure.
assets.evidence_basis: The 2026-09-01 focused conversion audit identifies G4 pilot evidence—not another feature sprint—as the highest-leverage unlock across OTF, TWNIC, NLnet, WebSci, ICWSM and future journalism/public-interest funding. The first serious pilot must remain bounded and independently witnessed; no partner outcome is claimed yet.

assets.name: Hardware Splicer
assets.strongest_known_gap: Revision-bound physical/live unseen proof and design-partner validation remain G4.
assets.evidence_basis: Substantial alpha code and internal verification exist; limited zero-help usability evidence does not establish physical or third-party hardware validation.

assets.name: Public-Good Control
assets.strongest_known_gap: Real operator / bounded coordination case remains G4.
assets.evidence_basis: Canonical main established 2026-08-27 after two independent development heads were integrated; GitHub Actions passed make verify and Docker build; no field outcome or partner adoption is claimed.

assets.name: Refinery / Commons
assets.strongest_known_gap: External evidence-audit case / adoption remains G4; current repository authority still needs a dedicated canonicalization audit.
assets.evidence_basis: Gauntlet gate audit treats the missing step as external evidence rather than more internal polish; repository mapping is intentionally left unresolved here.

assets.name: Sharpe Terminus
assets.strongest_known_gap: Genuine forward observations remain G4; subsystem/repository licensing and packaging should be audited separately before external release claims.
assets.evidence_basis: Quant subsystem is present in the canonical Research Drive repository; Gauntlet audit explicitly identifies forward evidence as the missing maturity gate.

assets.name: Research papers / thesis line
assets.strongest_known_gap: Confirmed empirical/reproducibility defects must be repaired before portfolio-readiness claims are upgraded.
assets.evidence_basis: Manuscripts exist and Invisible Ledger has conference acceptance evidence, but the current audit records confirmed empirical errors and an ECI raw-source reproducibility gap.

assets.name: Citation Engine
assets.strongest_known_gap: External adoption/community use and independent pressure-testing are not established.
assets.evidence_basis: Public reusable kernel with tests and internal cross-domain pressure testing; repository itself explicitly does not claim production-framework maturity.

assets.name: Gauntlet / Blowback
assets.strongest_known_gap: Canonical default-branch publication is being reconciled from cumulative operator, registry, faculty, HS, and portal-recon lines.
assets.evidence_basis: Current consolidation branch contains the master registry, conversion operator, Codex mission operator, faculty-pull routes, and HS/Nocturnal route packages; portal-recon semantics remain a separate conflict boundary.
